3. The present application has been filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedures,
1973, seeking bail in FIR No. 346/2019 dated 09.09.2019, registered at Police Station Kanjhawala,
for offences under Sections 498A/304B/201/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4.
5. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to file the status report.

6. Let the status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
7.
Let the nominal roll of the applicant be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing as well.

8. List on 30.04.2024.
